text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of people living with diabetes vs. GDP per capita 2024
Share of the population aged 20-79 with type I or II diabetes versus gross domestic product (GDP) per capita,
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Share living with diabetes (% of population ages 20 to 79)

tspan.tspan: International Diabetes Federation (Diabetes Atlas), via World Bank (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
